claims: Evaluate and manage hypotension, including titration of norepinephrine infusion and assessment of volume status.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas to reassess oxygenation, ventilation, and acid-base status.
Monitor oxygen saturation and titrate supplemental oxygen to maintain adequate oxygenation.
Monitor heart rate and blood pressure closely with arterial line.
Recheck serum potassium and replace as needed given hypokalemia.
Monitor renal function with serial creatinine and urine output.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit for anemia or bleeding.
Continue norepinephrine infusion to maintain mean arterial pressure.
Continue potassium chloride infusion for hypokalemia.
Assess volume status and consider fluid resuscitation or diuresis as appropriate.
